story.text: 오늘따라 왜 이렇게 예뻐 보이지... 아, 실례. 규현 기장입니다. 오늘 기장을 맡게 됐어요.
story.reading: o-neul-tta-ra wae i-reo-ke ye-ppeo bo-i-ji... a, sil-lye. gyu-hyeon gi-jang-im-ni-da. o-neul gi-jang-eul mat-ge dwae-sseo-yo.
story.en: Why do you look so pretty today... oh, excuse me. I'm Captain Kyuhyun. I'll be your captain today.

story.text: '승객' 여러분 중에 이렇게 눈에 띄는 분은 오랜만이라서요. 놀라지 마세요, 그냥 사실을 말한 거니까.
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun jung-e i-reo-ke nun-e ttui-neun bun-eun o-raen-man-i-ra-seo-yo. nol-la-ji ma-se-yo, geu-nyang sa-sil-eul mal-han geo-ni-kka.
story.en: It's been a while since a 'passenger' stood out to me like this. Don't be startled — I'm just stating a fact.

story.text: 이 '공항'에서 몇 년을 일했는데, 오늘처럼 설레는 탑승구는 처음이네요.
story.reading: i gong-hang-e-seo myeot nyeon-eul il-haet-neun-de, o-neul-cheo-reom seol-le-neun tap-seung-gu-neun cheo-eum-i-ne-yo.
story.en: I've worked at this 'airport' for years, but this is the first time a boarding gate has ever made me nervous like this.

story.text: 이번 '여행', 저랑 같은 노선이라니 이건 운명 아닌가요? 서울 하늘길, 제가 제일 잘 알거든요.
story.reading: i-beon yeo-haeng, jeo-rang gat-eun no-seon-i-ra-ni i-geon un-myeong a-nin-ga-yo? seo-ul ha-neul-gil, je-ga je-il jal al-geo-deun-yo.
story.en: This 'trip' just happens to be on my route? Isn't that fate? I know the Seoul skyway better than anyone.

story.text: 탑승하시면서 저 한 번 보고 웃으셨죠? 그 '미소' 때문에 오늘 비행 내내 기분이 좋을 것 같은데요.
story.reading: tap-seung-ha-si-myeon-seo jeo han beon bo-go u-seu-syeot-jyo? geu mi-so ttae-mun-e o-neul bi-haeng nae-nae gi-bun-i jo-eul geot gat-eun-de-yo.
story.en: You smiled at me when you boarded, didn't you? That 'smile' alone is probably going to keep me in a good mood the whole flight.

story.text: 기장이 승객 앞에서 이런 '설렘'을 느끼면 안 되는 건데... 뭐, 오늘만 봐주세요.
story.reading: gi-jang-i seung-gaek ap-e-seo i-reon seol-lem-eul neu-kki-myeon an doe-neun geon-de... mwo, o-neul-man bwa-ju-se-yo.
story.en: A captain isn't supposed to feel this kind of 'flutter' in front of a passenger... well, just let it slide for today.

story.text: 자, 이런 얘기만 하다간 이륙 못 하겠네요. 오늘 배운 표현들, 문제 풀면서 제대로 확인해볼까요?
story.reading: ja, i-reon yae-gi-man ha-da-gan i-ryuk mot ha-get-ne-yo. o-neul bae-un pyo-hyeon-deul, mun-je pul-myeon-seo je-dae-ro hwa-gin-hae-bol-kka-yo?
story.en: Alright, if I keep talking like this we'll never take off. Shall we check what we learned today by solving some questions?

words.example: 오늘 이 비행기에는 특별한 승객이 타셨네요.
words.example_reading: o-neul i bi-haeng-gi-e-neun teuk-byeol-han seung-gaek-i ta-syeon-ne-yo
words.example_en: There's a special passenger on this flight today.
I first met Captain Kyuhyun at the airport.

words.example: 이번 여행은 오래 기억날 것 같아요.
words.example_reading: i-beon yeo-haeng-eun o-rae gi-eok-nal geot gat-a-yo
words.example_en: I think I'll remember this trip for a long time.
I keep thinking about his smile.
The flutter began in front of the boarding gate.

sentences.en: Why do you look so pretty today.
We met again by chance at the airport.
This trip seems like it's going to be special.
Seeing his smile, I feel a flutter.
